note: Built as ballot/lean/mn_endorsements.json is. Each record is one line of one party page, matched to one race and one candidate on the Secretary of State's November list already loaded in ballot_local_2026.sqlite (office, district and name all fit, one fit only). North Dakota's parties endorse at district and state conventions before the June primary, so most candidates here are also their party's nominees. Three are not: Cara Cody-Braun (District 11 House) and Jolene Bruce (District 27 House) are on the ballot by independent nomination and the Dem-NPL's list marks each 'Independent, Dem-NPL Endorsed'; and Tracy Foss is a candidate for Superintendent of Public Instruction, a nonpartisan office, whom the Dem-NPL's page lists among the candidates 'officially endorsed at the 2026 North Dakota Democratic-NPL State Convention' (news reports describe the convention's act for that office as a letter of support; the party's page says endorsed, and the page is what is recorded). The same endorsement can stand on several pages (the Region 6 convention post and a candidate's own post): count a candidate once per party. The Dem-NPL's legislative list does not say 'endorsed' on a party candidate's own line, so those lines are under other_support with the reason in 'kind', never under endorsements. The Republican state party's own site has no page on its 2026 endorsements; one district unit's page (District 19) does. No party page read names a candidate for a county, court, soil conservation or Garrison Diversion contest. Read on 2026-10-02 with the kit's honest User-Agent, each site's robots.txt checked first: the two state parties' sites and every district or regional unit's own website linked from their directories (home page plus candidate, election and news pages, ten pages a site at most; searched for the word, and the pages that had it read). Facebook pages are social media and were not read. Every page in 'lists' was opened again after it was read, and a record is kept only if the page still showed it. Federal offices are outside this file.
